name: Mount Sharp boxwork: astronaut walk view data
frame: same local frame as web/terrain/terrain.json: x east of the west edge, y north of the south edge, z elevation (m, Mars areoid as in the USGS DEM). Heights are true (no exaggeration).
lat_note: planetocentric (Mars 2000 sphere); the page converts it to planetographic for Mars24

height.source: USGS MSL Gale DEM Mosaic 1 m v3 (Layer 2)

color.i: tile column from the west edge
color.j: tile row from the north edge
color.pattern_source: Calef, F.J. III, and Parker, T., 2016, MSL Gale Merged Orthophoto Mosaic 25 cm v3, USGS Astrogeology / PDS Annex (Layer 1, greyscale)

colour_source.title: Curiosity Surveys the Boxwork Region
colour_source.nasa_colour_note: This natural color view is approximately how the scene would appear to an average person if they were on Mars.
colour_source.where: Curiosity was inside this box on sol 4671 (Layer 4 waypoint 137.38127 E, 4.80827 S)

color.method: each orbital grey value keeps its brightness rank in the box and takes the median colour of the panorama's ground pixels with the same rank (ASSUMPTION A37)

sky.note: the panorama's sky reaches only part-way up; colour above its top is the top colour

walk.channels: R = class (0 UNKNOWN, 1 GO, 2 CAUTION, 3 NO-GO); G = 255 where you may walk
walk.rule: you may walk on GO or CAUTION ground that joins the base without crossing NO-GO or UNKNOWN (ASSUMPTION A39)

far.source: Mars MGS MOLA - MEX HRSC Blended DEM Global 200 m v2 (Fergason, Hare & Laura 2018, USGS), shifted by the median difference to the 1 m DEM inside the box

simulated.note: Detail finer than the real data (1 m shape, 25 cm photo) is made up so the ground looks real up close. It is not measured.

rocks.rule: team drone-sim rule (Drone/sim/scripts/02_route_flights.py): about 1 rock per 12 m of path, height gamma(2.2, 0.14) clipped to 0.15-0.7 m, width 0.5-1.2 m
rocks.per_m2_how: 1 per 12 m along a line / 0.85 m mean rock width (line-intercept) (ASSUMPTION A38)

ripples.rule: team drone-sim rule: 2.5 m wavelength, 6 cm, in DEM hollows >= 10 cm below a ~20 m running median with slope < 8 deg, at least 4 m across (adapted from 1D to 2D, ASSUMPTION A40)

sun.method: Mars24 (NASA GISS; Allison & McEwen 2000), see web/walk/mars24.js
sun.default_ltst_note: EVA start 09:00 local Mars time (team, safety.js START_HOUR)

walker.speed_note: team walking speed in a suit (safety.js SPEED)
